injuries.longComment: Greer suffered an upper-body injury in Sunday's 6-3 win over Ottawa. He will miss at least the next four games, starting with Tuesday's matchup against Vancouver, but it's unclear when he will be ready to return. Greer has four goals, six points, 23 shots on net and 36 hits in 13 appearances this season.
injuries.shortComment: Greer (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Monday.

injuries.longComment: "Troy is closer. When I say closer, hopefully, definitely, in the next, I'm gonna say, week or so," Quenneville told Lee. Terry hasn't played yet this campaign because of the injury. He had 19 goals and 57 points in 61 regular-season outings in 2025-26. The 29-year-old is expected to take on a top-six role once he's healthy.
injuries.shortComment: Although Terry's (hip) return doesn't appear to be imminent, he is getting close to playing, Derek Lee of The Hockey News reports Saturday.

injuries.longComment: Moore has been on injured reserve since the start of the regular season due to a lower-body injury he sustained on the first day of training camp. While he was given a return timetable of 2-4 weeks in mid-September, he's slated to miss more time than that, and he seems to have several steps to clear before he's in the mix to return to game action.
injuries.shortComment: Head coach Joel Quenneville said Friday that Moore (lower body) is still "a ways from skating," Patrick Present of The Hockey News reports.

injuries.longComment: Poehling was placed on injured reserve Tuesday morning, and the specifics of his injury have revealed that he's set to likely be sidelined into late November. In his absence, Roger McQueen, the 10th overall pick from the 2025 NHL Entry Draft, is expected to play in the team's middle six up the center of the ice. The 27-year-old Poehling was off to a solid start to the 2026-27 campaign prior to going down, posting a pair of points and solid category-coverage numbers across five games.
injuries.shortComment: Poehling (knee) is expected to miss 6-8 weeks with an MCL sprain.

injuries.longComment: After being placed on injured reserve early Saturday morning, Hagens' timeline for recovery has been revealed to keep him sidelined for at least the next five or six games. It's an unfortunate break for the Bruins and the 20-year-old winger, as he had posted six goals, 12 points, 34 shots on net and 19 blocked shots over 17 games prior to going down. His absence might hurt his rookie of the year case in the long run, but once he's able to return, he'll give the Bruins' third line a major boost. In his absence, expect the newly recalled Michael Eyssimont, who was named the AHL's player of the month for October, to take his place.
injuries.shortComment: Head coach Marco Sturm announced Saturday that Hagens (back) is expected to miss multiple weeks, per Jack Studley of Boston Hockey Now.

items.text: Hagens will miss at least the next two games, starting with Sunday's matchup against Florida, after being placed on the injured reserve list. He has contributed six goals, 12 points, 34 shots on net, 19 blocked shots and eight hits in 17 appearances this season.

items.headline: Hagens scored a goal on three shots in Monday's 3-2 shootout win over the Golden Knights.
items.text: Hagens has four goals and two assists over his last seven games. The 20-year-old forward continues to find consistent offense from a third-line role to help the Bruins to a 11-4-1 record so far. Hagens has six goals, six helpers, 30 shots on net, 19 blocked shots and a plus-7 rating across 16 appearances.

injuries.longComment: Helenius has missed the last two games and didn't participate in Monday's practice. He has contributed one goal, two assists, 12 shots on net, four blocked shots and 11 hits in 11 appearances this season.
injuries.shortComment: Helenius (upper body) is week-to-week, according to Matthew Fairburn of The Athletic on Monday.

injuries.longComment: Danforth's move to IR allowed the Sabres to activate Sam Carrick (middle body) ahead of Thursday's game versus the Ducks. Danforth remains without a clear timeline to return to action. He will miss his fourth straight game Thursday and will be eligible to return whenever ready, as long as he doesn't later end up on long-term injured reserve.
injuries.shortComment: Danforth (upper body) was placed on injured reserve Thursday, per the NHL media site.

injuries.longComment: According to the team, Lyon was originally expected to be in the crease for Tuesday's road clash with Montreal before suffering his setback. Even once given the all-clear, there may not be enough games to go around to make Lyon more than a low-end fantasy target, especially as long as Buffalo continues rostering three goalies.
injuries.shortComment: Lyon (upper body) had a setback in his recovery and is without a timeline to return, the team announced Thursday.

injuries.longComment: Buffalo placed Grzelcyk on injured reserve Tuesday. He hasn't played since Opening Night against Columbus on Oct. 1. With Rasmus Dahlin (upper body) and Grzelcyk unavailable, the Sabres recalled Dennis Gilbert from AHL Rochester to play against Montreal on Tuesday.
injuries.shortComment: Grzelcyk (lower body) suffered a "flare-up" and could be out for at least "a few days," head coach Lindy Ruff told Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Tuesday.

items.headline: Othmann (upper body) is not expected to be back in the lineup versus the Ducks on Friday, Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM reports.
items.text: Othmann is set to miss his fifth consecutive contest due to his upper-body injury. Prior to his absence, the 23-year-old winger was still looking for his first point of the season, having been left off the scoresheet in all six of his appearances. Even when healthy, Othmann is far from a lock to be in the lineup, and could serve as a healthy scratch periodically.

injuries.longComment: Bahl suffered the injury in pregame warmups before Friday's 5-3 loss to Anaheim. He will finish the 2026-27 campaign with one goal, one assist, 12 shots on net, 16 blocked shots and 22 hits in 16 appearances. The Flames placed Bahl on injured reserve before Sunday's matchup against Philadelphia and recalled Brayden Pachal from AHL Calgary.
injuries.shortComment: Bahl will undergo surgery for a ruptured Achilles tendon and won't play again in the 2026-27 season, the Flames announced Sunday.

items.headline: Bahl (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Sunday, according to Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM.
items.text: Bahl will miss his second straight game against Philadelphia on Sunday. He also won't be eligible for Wednesday's matchup against the Rangers after being placed on the IR list. However, it's unclear when he will be available to return to the lineup. Bahl has earned one goal, two points, 12 shots on net, 16 blocked shots and 22 hits in 16 appearances this season.

injuries.longComment: Huberdeau shouldn't be expected back in the lineup against the Ducks on Friday, but at this point, he could be cleared at any point. The final step in the 33-year-old winger's return to action will be his activation off injured reserve. In 50 games last year, Huberdeau produced 25 points and could be capable of topping that number once cleared to play.
injuries.shortComment: Huberdeau (hip) took the ice in a regular jersey Friday, Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM reports.
